cases.prepared_summary: Owner-occupied furniture warehouse in Greater Manchester, England · 1,200 m² · Buildings £2 million · Maximum stock £600,000

Company.label: Proposer
Company.value: Northbridge Furniture Storage Ltd; private limited company, established 2018.

Company.label: Activity
Company.value: Wholesale distribution and temporary storage of new domestic furniture; no manufacture, upholstery, spray painting or public showroom.

Company.label: Registration identifier
Company.value: Intentionally omitted for this synthetic case.

Premises.label: Location
Premises.value: Unit 4, Example Distribution Park, Greater Manchester, England; fictional address, no valid postcode supplied.

Premises.label: Occupation
Premises.value: Company owns and occupies the whole premises; no tenants, shared occupiers or vacant areas.

Premises.label: Area and age
Premises.value: 1,200 m² total: 1,000 m² warehouse (2004) and 200 m² extension (2019); includes 100 m² office area.

Premises.label: Construction
Premises.value: Steel frame, brick/block lower walls, profiled metal upper walls and metal roof; extension composite-panel core specification not supplied.

Requested cover.label: Cover request
Requested cover.value: Property damage, theft and business interruption on an all-risks basis, subject to insurer terms; no cover bound.

Requested cover.label: Extensions
Requested cover.value: Accidental damage and theft requested; flood, storm, escape of water and subsidence for consideration. Terrorism quotation requested separately.

Declared values.label: Buildings
Declared values.value: £2,000,000 requested reinstatement sum including extension; client estimate, no recent professional assessment supplied.

Declared values.label: Stock
Declared values.value: £600,000 maximum anticipated including seasonal peaks; indicative current holding £450,000.

Business interruption.label: Sum and indemnity period
Business interruption.value: £1,200,000 estimated insurance gross profit; 24-month maximum indemnity period.

Business interruption.label: Calculation basis
Business interruption.value: Calculation and uninsured working expenses not supplied.

Business interruption.label: Continuity
Business interruption.value: One supplier accounts for approximately 35% of purchases; replacement stock lead time six to eight weeks; no alternative warehouse contracted.

History.label: June 2024 loss
History.value: Client reports toilet supply-pipe escape of water; £4,800 paid, no outstanding reserve reported; pipe section replaced and isolation valve labelled.

History.label: Other losses
History.value: Client reports no other insured or uninsured property losses in the five years to 22 October 2026.

History.label: Previous insurance
History.value: Property and business interruption cover reported until 30 November 2026; expiring schedule and insurer loss run not enclosed.

History.label: Insurance history
History.value: Client reports no prior cancellation, avoidance or refusal to renew; not independently checked.
